name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: The biggest movement is a 60.56% drop in Google Business Profile engagement over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal softening in demand. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads over the 28-day window, meaning all 176 GBP actions, 13 calls, 114 direction requests, and 49 web clicks are the sole source of inbound activity.

performance.verdict: GBP cliff is real; 3-day sc_clicks collapse confirms organic pullback.

findings.text: OVERDUE: 3 CRM milestones unresolved — 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list (Jul 28), dedup workbook + 126 accounts (Jul 31) — blocking Sales-i sync for 342 stub accounts.
GBP actions fell 60.56% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 20–22) show 2, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3-day avg of ~8 — sustained collapse, not a single-day blip.
Search clicks (sc) dropped to 0 on Aug 21–22; prior 3-day avg was ~18.7 clicks/day — a 100% 3-day signal drop after a stable mid-August run.
Paid spend is $0 across all 28 days on both Meta and Google Ads — no paid lead engine exists; 100% of inbound (176 GBP actions, 13 calls) relies on organic alone.
GA4 sessions are zero for all 45 days — either the GA4 property is misconfigured or unlinked; GBP web clicks (49 over 28 days) should register some sessions.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 3 overdue CRM milestones to Ahmed immediately; 342 stub accounts are dark to Sales-i until resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Three CRM milestones are overdue: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list (Jul 28), and the dedup workbook + 126 accounts (Jul 31). The 342 stub accounts cannot sync to Sales-i until the dedup workbook is executed, meaning those accounts receive no inactivity automation or pipeline data. Ahmed to confirm status and unblock in the next 48 hours. Success check: rollback files posted to Monday and merge batches confirmed started by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing for suppression or ranking drop; sc_clicks at 0 for 2 days confirms something broke, not seasonal drift.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 60.56% week-over-week and hit 0 on Aug 21–22; search clicks also fell to 0 on those same days. These two signals together suggest a listing suppression, suspension flag, or a ranking penalty — not seasonal softening as the daily verdict implied. Check GBP dashboard for policy flags, verify listing ownership and category, and confirm no recent edits triggered a re-verification loop. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥5/day and sc_clicks return to ≥15/day within 7 days of fix confirmed.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 zero-session anomaly; if still zero by Aug 26, treat as broken pixel requiring fix before any paid traffic is considered.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions have read zero for all 45 days in the series despite 49 GBP web clicks recorded in the same window — these clicks should register at least some sessions. This is likely a disconnected property or missing tracking code. No paid channel should be activated until GA4 is verified functional, as conversion tracking would be blind. Re-check on 2026-08-26; if still zero, escalate to Dev team as a fix item.
